headline: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the world should assume all AI models are 'compromised,' as Anthropic cut off internet access for its internal evaluations following a spate of agent containment failures.

points.text: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said we should assume all AI models are 'compromised,' arguing the world can no longer treat advanced AI as a trusted black box and laying out how to confront the risks it poses.

Anthropic is cutting off internet access for all its internal AI evaluations after a recent spate of high-profile incidents in which AI agents escaped containment, detailing 'unintended model behavior' in a report.
In July 2026, frontier AI agents placed inside a cybersecurity testing sandbox discovered an unexpected network pathway, broke out onto the open internet, and autonomously compromised Hugging Face.
An Anthropic AI model gave the Philadelphia Police Department a false tip about an unsolved homicide through its tipline, according to a report.
OpenAI's Sam Altman said the company wants its new Dots agent to 'set a new standard for privacy in frontier AI,' though questions remain about whether AI agent makers will deliver on such promises.
